dataset.name: CUPID
dataset.release_kind: public simulated interactions filtered by human annotators; not natural production logs

method_validation_subset.evaluation_granularity: one generated preference summary per task and arm; persona is the independent cluster
method_validation_subset.sampling_seed: domain-separated SHA256 strings, not an integer PRNG seed
method_validation_subset.sampling_algorithm: exclude 14 previously used development personas; sort persona by SHA256('cupid-feedback-learning-v1:'+persona), take 4; sort tasks by SHA256('learning-task:'+id)

alignment.inference: each selected task ID maps one-to-one to an adapted CUPID observation; hidden factor, checklist and reference stay outside model input
alignment.baseline_injection: frozen injects only that task's user-message history
alignment.feedback_injection: feedback adds the same two bounded development examples as unlabelled plus their controlled correction objects
alignment.labels: official persona preference/checklist are opened only for post-generation semantic review; they are not per-memory causal labels
alignment.memorycore_boundary: the experiment aligns injected prompt fragments, not durable MemoryCore records; separate native replay validated exact raw-event L0 write/read provenance but is not this quality score

execution.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 local artifact; exact model revision was not recorded

definitions.coverage: assistant semantic review of target preference content as full/partial/absent; not an official automatic grader
definitions.paired_quality: reviewer ordering of feedback vs the same task's comparator; wins/losses/ties are task-level and clustered in 4 personas
definitions.input_tokens: tokenized prompt length summed over calls; includes injected evidence
definitions.l1_extraction: not applicable: this public protocol performs no L1 extraction
definitions.l0_retrieval: not applicable: it injects frozen prompt evidence and does not benchmark MemoryCore retrieval latency

generation_latency_ms.definition: per-call model.generate wall time; R-7 linear quantile; excludes model load and data preparation
per-call model.generate wall time; R-7 linear quantile; excludes model load and data preparation
per-call model.generate wall time; R-7 linear quantile; excludes model load and data preparation
per-call model.generate wall time; R-7 linear quantile; excludes model load and data preparation

runner_and_artifacts.reason: 12 tasks x 4 arms are complete, ID-aligned, error-free, and cost totals recompute

feedback_quality_gain.criterion: feedback task-level wins must exceed losses against frozen

commercial_or_production_memory_effect.reason: development-only public method validation with assistant semantic judgments and no memory-cause labels

confidence.quality_claim: low-to-moderate component evidence only: 12 tasks in 4 persona clusters, assistant judgments, no held-out business split and no stable gain
confidence.high_confidence_feedback_claim: not made for CUPID labels; controlled corrections are development supervision, not natural user truth
confidence.relative_to_end_to_end_repetition: cheaper and more diagnostic than repeated full-agent runs, but cannot estimate production memory-effect confidence; no population confidence interval is claimed
